updates.note: Management reaffirmed double-digit revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
updates.quote: As far as revenue growth is concerned, we are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.

updates.note: Delivery of LCA Mark-1A and HTT-40 pushed to August/September 2026.
updates.quote: So we are hoping to resolve everything and stabilize by August or September.

updates.note: EBITDA margin guidance reaffirmed at 30% to 31%.
updates.quote: And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

updates.note: Tejas Mark-2 prototype rollout expected by last quarter of this year (March 2027).
updates.quote: So we are expecting in the last quarter of this year, for the rollout of Mark II.

updates.note: Targeting around 20 LCA deliveries for FY27.
updates.quote: That's 20, this year, we are planning to deliver.

new_promises.statement: Invest around INR 12,000 crores in manufacturing infrastructure projects by 2030.
new_promises.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota

new_promises.statement: Receive orders of INR 90,000 crores including ROH orders during the next 2 years.
new_promises.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota

new_promises.statement: Roll out Tejas Mark II prototype by March 2027.
new_promises.quote: So we are expecting that by March, we should be able to roll out Mark II.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota
